title: Add OpenAI-compatible GET /v1/models/:model
author: xiaotian1171
pr_body_excerpt:
Retrieve a single model by ID or alias through the same registry view
as the list endpoint. Extract one shared mapper so both routes return
identical payloads, now including owned_by and stable created
timestamps derived from the registry addedDate instead of per-request
wall-clock values. Unknown, hidden, permission-filtered, and
paid-only-inaccessible models all collapse to the same 404. Add 404 to
the known error status codes and cover the endpoint with route tests
for alias resolution, mapper parity with the list payload, permission
and paid-balance rules.

Closes #13795

gist.headline: One model, right this way
gist.blurb: The model registry grew a front desk. Ask for a model by ID or alias, and it hands back the same tidy record as the full catalog.
gist.summary: Added an OpenAI-compatible GET /v1/models/:model endpoint that resolves model IDs and aliases through the shared registry mapper, returning list-parity payloads with owned_by and stable created timestamps from addedDate.
gist.impact: OpenAI-compatible clients can now inspect one accessible model directly, while unknown, hidden, permission-filtered, and unavailable paid models consistently return 404.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a cozy library clerk in a garden-like model registry, retrieving one labeled model card from a neatly organized catalog drawer while a CRT monitor robot checks that the card matches the catalog. Model ID and alias signposts lead to the same card, representing shared lookup and payload parity.
